name: Zoom Blur Slideshow
description: Full-screen WebGL image slideshow that transitions between photos with a radial zoom blur centered on the mouse, driven by wheel, click, swipe, keyboard or autoplay.
contents: Full-screen WebGL canvas showing image slides
Dot indicators for the active slide
behavior: Zoom blur shader blends the current and next image
Blur center follows the mouse with smoothing
Wheel scrolling inside the slider scrubs progress
Click top or bottom half, arrow keys, swipe, or autoplay change slides
editableByProps: Images, blur strength, samples, transition and intro timing
Input methods, autoplay, dots and their colors, background color, camera settings, button labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blur algorithm or look

needsCodeEdit.where: button elements inside the enableClick block

fixed: Root is full-width and viewport height (h-screen). Override with className.
Wheel events over the slider are captured with preventDefault, so the page does not scroll while the pointer is over it
Arrow keys are listened to on window
Requires WebGL and at least 2 images
